scope: Tracked and nonignored current-change files copied into an isolated temporary tree. No existing artifacts, model weights, runtime assets, virtual environment or CORD source images copied. Saved invoice/model workflow evidence is audited offline, and the replay is prepared through the public CLI. The verifier is the invoking script identified by its hash. Remote clone availability, fresh inference, browser behavior and human review are not checked. Full CORD rescoring requires explicit dataset setup.
